# TimelineIdGenerator { #timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator }

```python
TimelineIdGenerator(_counters=dict(), _id_to_meta=dict())
```

Generates systematic timeline IDs based on type.

Timeline IDs follow the pattern ``{prefix}{N}`` where prefix
encodes the timeline type (domain + continuity) and N is a
1-indexed counter scoped to this generator instance.

When a role is specified, the ID becomes ``{role}:{prefix}{N}``
(e.g., ``score:clt1``, ``perf:dlt3``).

The counter N is scoped per prefix per generator. Each generator
instance maintains its own counter state, so different loaders
do not interfere with each other.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                                               | Description                                      |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| _counters   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [int](`int`)\]                                       | Per-prefix counter state.                        |
| _id_to_meta | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [object](`object`)\]\] | Maps generated IDs to metadata dicts for lookup. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> gen = TimelineIdGenerator()
>>> gen.next_id("ContinuousLogicalTimeline")
'clt1'
>>> gen.next_id("ContinuousLogicalTimeline")
'clt2'
>>> gen.next_id("DiscreteLogicalTimeline")
'dlt1'
>>> gen.next_id_with_role("DiscreteLogicalTimeline", "perf")
'perf:dlt2'
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_meta](#timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.get_meta) | Retrieve metadata associated with a generated ID. |
| [next_id](#timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.next_id) | Generate the next ID for a given timeline type. |
| [next_id_with_role](#timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.next_id_with_role) | Generate the next ID with a role prefix. |
| [reset](#timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.reset) | Reset all counters and metadata. |

### get_meta { #timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.get_meta }

```python
TimelineIdGenerator.get_meta(timeline_id)
```

Retrieve metadata associated with a generated ID.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description                         | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|-------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) | A previously generated timeline ID. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                                           |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [object](`object`)\] \| None | The metadata dict, or None if no metadata was stored. |

### next_id { #timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.next_id }

```python
TimelineIdGenerator.next_id(timeline_type, *, meta=None)
```

Generate the next ID for a given timeline type.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                       | Description                                  | Default    |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_type | [type](`type`) \| [str](`str`)                             | A timeline class or class name string.       | _required_ |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [object](`object`)\] \| None | Optional metadata to associate with this ID. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                         |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | [str](`str`) | An ID like ``clt1``, ``dlt2``, etc. |

### next_id_with_role { #timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.next_id_with_role }

```python
TimelineIdGenerator.next_id_with_role(timeline_type, role, *, meta=None)
```

Generate the next ID with a role prefix.

The role is prepended as ``{role}:{prefix}{N}``.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                       | Description                                  | Default    |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_type | [type](`type`) \| [str](`str`)                             | A timeline class or class name string.       | _required_ |
| role          | [str](`str`)                                               | The role prefix (e.g., 'score', 'perf').     | _required_ |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [object](`object`)\] \| None | Optional metadata to associate with this ID. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                               |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------|
|        | [str](`str`) | An ID like ``score:clt1``, ``perf:dlt3``. |

### reset { #timetoalign.TimelineIdGenerator.reset }

```python
TimelineIdGenerator.reset()
```

Reset all counters and metadata.
